verdict.rationale: Terraform is a CLI built for non-interactive automation. `-auto-approve` skips interactive approval, `-out=FILE` saves plans to apply later, and `-var`/`-var-file` inject inputs without prompts. `-json` emits line-delimited machine-readable output for plan/apply/test and `show`, and the state commands are built for Unix-tool pipelines; a community user reports automatically rebuilding all their infra with it. missing for 10: an explicit first-party CI/automation guide (e.g. env-var input handling, non-TTY behavior) in the evidence, and independent hands-on reports specifically about CI pipeline usage.
